entries.name: _draw
entries.summary: Define this callback to draw one frame.

entries.name: _init
entries.summary: Define this callback to initialize the game once after startup.

entries.name: _update
entries.summary: Define this callback for game logic at the normal 30 Hz update rate.

entries.name: _update60
entries.summary: Define this callback instead of _update for 60 Hz game logic.

entries.name: abs
entries.summary: Always fixed: abs(the minimum integer) saturates to the largest fractional value, which cannot be represented by the narrow integer optimization.

entries.name: add
entries.summary: Add a value or entity to a supported collection.

entries.name: all
entries.summary: Iterate over every live element in a pool.

entries.name: array8
entries.summary: Create a compact fixed-capacity byte array.

entries.name: band
entries.summary: PICO-8 bitwise FUNCTION forms - exact aliases of the operators gtlua already has (a & b, a | b, ...). Carts use both spellings interchangeably. Emitted as the operator, so zero runtime cost. band/bor/bxor/bnot on the raw bits; shl/shr shift (shr = arithmetic >>, lshr = logical >>>).

entries.name: btn
entries.summary: Test whether a controller button is held.

entries.name: btnp
entries.summary: Test whether a controller button was just pressed, including repeat.

entries.name: camera
entries.summary: sticky draw offset added to everything (no args = reset)

entries.name: chr
entries.summary: Allocation-free static form: every byte must be a compile-time constant.

entries.name: cls
entries.summary: Clear the screen with an optional color.

entries.name: count
entries.summary: PICO-8 count(t): pools report their live element count; fixed arrays report their capacity (all slots are always present in gtlua's static model).

entries.name: del
entries.summary: Remove a matching value or entity from a supported collection.

entries.name: deli
entries.summary: Remove an item by numeric index.

entries.name: dget
entries.summary: Read a persistent numeric save slot.

entries.name: dset
entries.summary: Write a persistent numeric save slot.

entries.name: fget
entries.summary: PICO-8 sprite flags. fget(n) -> all 8 flag bits fget(n, f) -> 0/1 for flag f fset(n, v) -> replace all 8 bits fset(n, f, v) -> set/clear flag f

entries.name: gt.autocls
entries.summary: clear to color c automatically each frame (free - happens while the screen is between frames)

entries.name: gt.bg_coln
entries.summary: paint one tile column into the canvas

entries.name: gt.bg_compose
entries.signature: gt.bg_compose(map, cols, cx, cy, cw, ch)
entries.summary: CPU-paint a tilemap into the canvas

entries.name: gt.bg_tile
entries.summary: stamp one sheet tile into the canvas

entries.name: gt.canvas_view
entries.summary: window blit from the composed canvas

entries.name: gt.chunks_draw
entries.signature: gt.chunks_draw(grid, lut, lut2, props, stride, cx0, cy0, cx1, cy1)

entries.name: gt.dbar

entries.summary: fast segmented bar (HUD meters); v of max m, bg >= 16 skips the strip

entries.name: gt.dbar_style
entries.summary: bar look: px-per-unit scale (/256), strip width, height, deficit color

entries.name: gt.drift_draw_range
entries.summary: layered range draw: (first, count, camdx8, camdy8) - clouds behind the map and snow in front share one engine

entries.name: gt.drift_draw_range_cpu
entries.summary: the 4-piece 128x128 canvas window blit (scrolling composed maps) flakes draw through CPU pokes (1x1 fields, frame-tail only)

entries.name: gt.drift_mode
entries.summary: follower chain (hair/tails): eases 5 segments toward (x,y), draws p8 round dots r=2,2,1,1,1 in the given color - all in asm (gt_flakes.s)

entries.name: gt.drift_set
entries.signature: gt.drift_set(index, x, y, width, height, speed8, color)

entries.name: gt.gspr

entries.name: gt.hit_scan
entries.signature: gt.hit_scan(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7, arg8)

entries.name: gt.mark
entries.summary: benchmark/test cycle marker: writes GT_MARK_ADDR so the GT_PROFILE core build can bracket measured regions. No effect on normal carts.

entries.name: gt.phys_bounds
entries.summary: set the walls balls bounce in (default: the whole screen); vymin = how fast a falling ball must move to bounce off the floor (0 = always)

entries.name: gt.phys_draw

entries.name: gt.phys_step

entries.name: gt.pool_anim
entries.summary: advance animation frames (16ths; past maxf snaps to reset, default 16 = first frame)

entries.name: gt.pool_decay
entries.summary: per-slot sum += table[act-1]; lm[i] -= step (floor 0); returns the sum

entries.name: gt.pool_edraw
entries.signature: gt.pool_edraw(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7)

entries.name: hexdata
entries.summary: Create a compile-time byte array from hexadecimal text.

entries.name: map
entries.summary: Draw a rectangular region of the tile map.

entries.name: mget
entries.summary: the tile index at map cell (cx, cy)

entries.name: music
entries.summary: `loop` is a truthy flag (default on): music(0) loops, music(0,false) plays once.

entries.name: ord
entries.summary: Static-string subset: literal input and optional literal 1-based index. Dynamic strings / multi-result ord remain part of the later string runtime.

entries.name: palt
entries.summary: GameTank hardware supports only its native color-0 colorkey. palt() resets it; palt(0,false) makes zero opaque. Other colors are rejected by emit.

entries.name: print
entries.summary: Draw text and return the final horizontal position.

entries.name: reset
entries.summary: Alias of run; restart the cartridge from power-on state.

entries.name: run
entries.summary: Restart the cartridge from power-on state.

entries.name: sfx
entries.summary: ---- sound (gt_music.c) -------------------------------------------------- sfx(n, [ch]) - fire built-in effect n (0-7); ch omitted = auto channel. music(n, [loop]) - start built-in tune n; music(-1) stops (PICO-8). `audio` pulls in gt_audio_init()+gt_music.o at build time.

entries.name: sget
entries.summary: PICO-8 sget(x,y): read a sprite-sheet pixel (raw GameTank color byte).

entries.name: song
entries.summary: song(data, [loop]) - play a native .gtm2 FM song (Clyde's format); data is a hexdata() blob. loop defaults on. gt.song_stop() halts it. See docs/MUSIC.md.

entries.name: spr
entries.summary: Draw one or more 8x8 sprite-sheet cells.

entries.name: sprf
entries.summary: Draw a named frame from the project's frame table.

entries.name: sset
entries.summary: write a pixel into the sprite sheet (bake sprites at runtime)

entries.name: sspr
entries.signature: sspr(sx, sy, sw, sh, dx, dy, [dw], [dh], [flip_x], [flip_y])
entries.summary: Draw and optionally scale a rectangle from the sprite sheet.
